ব্যাংক ডেইলি কুইজ.question: ১) An outgoing pipe is attached to a tank that can empty it in 18 hours. An ingoing pipe is connected to the tank that can fill it in 4 hours. How much time will it take to fill the half-full tank?
ব্যাংক ডেইলি কুইজ.exp:
Question: An outgoing pipe is attached to a tank that can empty it in 18 hours. An ingoing pipe is connected to the tank that can fill it in 4 hours. How much time will it take to fill the half-full tank?

Solution: 
Ingoing pipe in one hour can fill = 1/4 parts
Outgoing pipe in one hour can empty = 1/18 parts

In, one hour total fill up = (1/4) - (1/18) = 7/36 parts

To fill half the tank it will take = 36/(7 × 2) hours
= 18/7 hours.

ব্যাংক ডেইলি কুইজ.question: ২) Water flows through a cylindrical pipe of an internal diameter of 7cm at the rate of 5m/s. The time, in minutes, the pipe would take to fill an empty rectangular tank of 4m × 3m × 2.31m is -
ব্যাংক ডেইলি কুইজ.exp:
Question: Water flows through a cylindrical pipe of an internal diameter of 7cm at the rate of 5m/s. The time, in minutes, the pipe would take to fill an empty rectangular tank of 4m × 3m × 2.31m is - 

Solution: 
The total volume of the tank is = 400 × 300 × 231 cc
Total water flow per second through the pipe is = πr2h
= (22/7) × (7/2)2 × 500

∴ Total time = (400 × 300 × 231)/{(22/7) × (7/2)2 × 500}
= (400 × 300 × 231 × 4 × 7)/(22 × 49 × 500)
= 1440 s 
= 24 min

ব্যাংক ডেইলি কুইজ.question: ৩) 12 buckets of water fill a tank when the capacity of each bucket is 16 liters. How many buckets will be needed to fill the same tank if the capacity of each bucket is 6 liters?
ব্যাংক ডেইলি কুইজ.exp:
Question: 12 buckets of water fill a tank when the capacity of each bucket is 16 liters. How many buckets will be needed to fill the same tank, if the capacity of each bucket is 6 liters?

Solution: 
Total capacity of the tank is = (12 × 16) = 192 liters.

∴ Total buckets of 6 liters needed = 192/6 
= 32

ব্যাংক ডেইলি কুইজ.question: ৪) Tap A fills a tank in 6 hours, whereas tap B empties the tank in 20 hours. A and B are opened alternately for 1 hour each. Every 2 hours, the level of water is found to increase by 0.5m. The depth of the tank is -
ব্যাংক ডেইলি কুইজ.exp:
Question: Tap A fills a tank in 6 hours, whereas tap B empties the tank in 20 hours. A and B are opened alternately for 1 hour each. Every 2 hours, the level of water is found to increase by 0.5m. The depth of the tank is - 

Solution: 
Let the depth of the tank be h m

In, two hours total fill-up = (1/6) - (1/20) parts
= 7/60 parts

ATQ,
(7/60)h = 0.5
⇒ h = 60/(2 × 7)
⇒ h = 30/7
∴ h = 4.2

ব্যাংক ডেইলি কুইজ.question: ৫) How long will it take for two pipes to fill a tank together when they can fill it alone in 16 hours and 24 hours respectively?
ব্যাংক ডেইলি কুইজ.exp:
Question: How long will it take for two pipes to fill a tank together when they can fill it alone in 16 hours and 24 hours respectively?

Solution:
Together in one hour, they can fill = (1/16) + (1/24) parts
= 5/48 parts

So, the total time to fill the tank is = 48/5 hours
= 9.6 hours 
= 9 hours 36 minutes

ব্যাংক ডেইলি কুইজ.question: ৬) A tank with a capacity of T liters is empty. If water flows into the tank from pipe M at the rate of m liters per minute and water is pumped out by N at the rate of n liters per minute, and m > n, then in how many minutes will the tank be filled?
ব্যাংক ডেইলি কুইজ.exp:
Question: A tank with a capacity of T liters is empty. If water flows into the tank from pipe M at the rate of m liters per minute and water is pumped out by N at the rate of n liters per minute, and m > n, then in how many minutes will the tank be filled?

Solution:
Given,
Tank capacity = T liters
Inflow rate (pipe M) = m liters/min
Outflow rate (pipe N) = n liters/min

Now,
Per minute fill up = m - n liters

∴ Total time to fill the tank is = T/(m - n)

ব্যাংক ডেইলি কুইজ.question: ৭) If a tank has a length of 8 meters, a width of 4 meters, and a height of 1.5 meters, what is the volume of the tank?
ব্যাংক ডেইলি কুইজ.exp:
Question: If a tank has a length of 8 meters, a width of 4 meters, and a height of 1.5 meters, what is the volume of the tank?

Solution:
দেওয়া আছে, 
চৌবাচ্চার দৈর্ঘ্য = 8 মিটার
প্রস্থ = 4 মিটার
এবং উচ্চতা 1.5 মিটার

আমরা জানি, 
আয়তন = দৈর্ঘ্য × প্রস্থ × উচ্চতা
 = 8 × 4 × 1.5 ঘনমিটার
= 48 ঘনমিটার

ব্যাংক ডেইলি কুইজ.question: ৮) A vessel has three pipes connected to it, two to supply liquid and one to draw liquid. The first and second pipe can fill the vessel in 9/2 and 3 hours, and the third can empty it in 3/2 hours. If all the pipes are open simultaneously when the vessel is one-third full, how soon will it be emptied?
ব্যাংক ডেইলি কুইজ.exp:
Question: A vessel has three pipes connected to it, two to supply liquid and one to draw liquid. The first and second pipe can fill the vessel in 9/2 and 3 hours, and the third can empty it in 3/2 hours. If all the pipes are open simultaneously when the vessel is one-third full, how soon will it be emptied?

Solution:
Pipe 1 (Filling) = 1/(9/2) = 2/9 of the vessel per hour.
Pipe 2 (Filling) = 1/3 of the vessel per hour.
Pipe 3 (Emptying) = 1/(3/2) = 2/3 of the vessel per hour

In one hour the tank will be emptied = (2/3) - [(2/9) + (1/3)]
= 1/9 parts

∴ The vessel will be emptied in = 9/3 hours
= 3 hours

ব্যাংক ডেইলি কুইজ.question: ৯) Two pipes can fill a tank in 40 and 48 minutes, respectively, and a waste pipe can empty 3 gallons per minute. All three pipes working together can fill the tank in 30 minutes. The capacity of the tank is -
ব্যাংক ডেইলি কুইজ.exp:
Question: Two pipes can fill a tank in 40 and 48 minutes, respectively, and a waste pipe can empty 3 gallons per minute. All three pipes working together can fill the tank in 30 minutes. The capacity of the tank is -

Solution: 
Work done by the waste pipe in 1 minute = (1/30) - [(1/40) + (1/48)]
= (1/30) - (11/220)
= - (1/80) parts 
Here, negative sign means emptying.
 
Now,
Volume of (1/80) part = 3 gallons
∴ Volume of the whole tank = (3 × 80) gallons
= 240 gallons

ব্যাংক ডেইলি কুইজ.question: ১০) A tank is filled by two pipes in 10 minutes. If both pipes are opened and after 5 minutes the first pipe is closed, it takes another 8 minutes to fill the tank. How long would it take for the second pipe alone to fill the tank?
ব্যাংক ডেইলি কুইজ.exp:
Question: A tank is filled by two pipes in 10 minutes. If both pipes are opened and after 5 minutes the first pipe is closed, it takes another 8 minutes to fill the tank. How long would it take for the second pipe alone to fill the tank?

Solution:
১ম ও ২য় নল দ্বারা 10 মিনিটে পূর্ণ হয় সম্পূর্ণ বা 1 অংশ।
∴ ১ম ও ২য় নল দ্বারা 1 মিনিটে পূর্ণ হয় 1/10 অংশ।
∴ ১ম ও ২য় নল দ্বারা 5 মিনিটে পূর্ণ হয় = 5/10 = 1/2 অংশ।

∴ বাকি থাকে চৌবাচ্চার = 1 - (1/2) অংশ = 1/2 অংশ।

∴ ২য় নল দ্বারা চৌবাচ্চার 1/2 অংশ পূর্ণ হয় = 8 মিনিটে
∴ ২য় নল দ্বারা চৌবাচ্চার 1 বা সম্পূর্ণ অংশ পূর্ণ হয় = 8 × 2 = 16 মিনিটে

সুতরাং, শুধু দ্বিতীয় নল দিয়ে চৌবাচ্চা পূর্ণ করতে 16 মিনিট লাগবে।

ব্যাংক ডেইলি কুইজ.question: ১১) A tank is 7 meters long and 4 meters wide. At what speed should water run through a pipe 5 cm broad and 4 cm deep so that in 6 hours and 18 minutes, the water level in the tank rises by 4.5 meters?
ব্যাংক ডেইলি কুইজ.exp:
Question: A tank is 7 meters long and 4 meters wide. At what speed should water run through a pipe 5 cm broad and 4 cm deep so that in 6 hours and 18 minutes, the water level in the tank rises by 4.5 meters?

Solution: 
Rate of flow of water = x cm/minute
∴ Volume of water that flowed in 1 minute
= (5 × 4 × x) = 20 x cu.cm.
∴ Volume of water that flowed in the tank in 6 hours and 18 minutes.
i.e. (6 × 60 + 18) = 378 minutes is (20x × 378) cu . cm.

According to the question,
20x × 378 = 700 × 400 × 450
∴ x = (700 × 400 × 450)/(20 × 378) cm/min
= (700 × 400 × 450 × 60)/(20 × 378 × 100000) km/hours 
= 10 km/hours

ব্যাংক ডেইলি কুইজ.question: ১২) A tank can be filled by three pipes in 6, 9, and 18 hours respectively. If all three pipes are opened together, how long will it take to fill the entire tank?
ব্যাংক ডেইলি কুইজ.exp:
Question: A tank can be filled by three pipes in 6, 9, and 18 hours respectively. If all three pipes are opened together, how long will it take to fill the entire tank?

Solution: 
প্রথম নল 1 ঘণ্টায় পূর্ণ করে = 1/6 অংশ 
দ্বিতীয় নল 1 ঘণ্টায় পূর্ণ করে = 1/9 অংশ 
তৃতীয় নল 1 ঘণ্টায় পূর্ণ করে = 1/18 অংশ 

∴ তিনটি নল একই সাথে 1 ঘণ্টায় পূর্ণ করে = {(1/6) + (1/9) + (1/18)} অংশ 
= (3 + 2 + 1)/18 অংশ 
= 6/18 অংশ 
= 1/3 অংশ 

চৌবাচ্চার 1/3 অংশ পূর্ণ হয় = 1 ঘণ্টায়
∴ চৌবাচ্চার 1 বা সম্পূর্ণ অংশ পূর্ণ হয় = (1 × 3) ঘণ্টায় 
= 3 ঘণ্টায়

ব্যাংক ডেইলি কুইজ.question: ১৩) A completely empty tank can be filled by one pipe in 5 hours. A second pipe can fill the tank in 3 hours. If both pipes are used together, how long will it take to fill two-third of the tank?
ব্যাংক ডেইলি কুইজ.exp:
Question: A completely empty tank can be filled by one pipe in 5 hours. A second pipe can fill the tank in 3 hours. If both pipes are used together, how long will it take to fill two-third of the tank?

Solution: 
প্রথম পাইপ দ্বারা, 1 ঘণ্টায় ভর্তি হয় = 1/5 অংশ
দ্বিতীয় পাইপ দ্বারা, 1 ঘণ্টায় ভর্তি হয় = 1/3 অংশ
দুটি পাইপ দ্বারা একত্রে 1 ঘণ্টায় ভর্তি করে = (1/5) + (1/3) অংশ = 8/15 অংশ 

8/15 অংশ চৌবাচ্চা ভর্তি হয় = 1 ঘণ্টায়
∴ 2/3 অংশ চৌবাচ্চা ভর্তি হয় = (15 × 2)/(8 × 3) ঘণ্টায়
= 30/24 ঘণ্টায় 
= 5/4 ঘণ্টায়

ব্যাংক ডেইলি কুইজ.question: ১৪) An outlet pipe can completely empty a cistern in 5 hours. How long will it take to empty three-fifths of the cistern?
ব্যাংক ডেইলি কুইজ.exp:
Question: An outlet pipe can completely empty a cistern in 5 hours. How long will it take to empty three-fifths of the cistern?

Solution: 
The outlet pipe empties the one complete cistern in 5 hours
Time taken to empty 3/5 Part of the cistern = (3/5) × 5
= 3 hours
= (3 × 60) minutes
= 180 minutes

ব্যাংক ডেইলি কুইজ.question: ১৫) A tank has a length of 6 meters, a width of 3 meters, and a height of 5 meters. What is the water-holding capacity of the tank in liters?
ব্যাংক ডেইলি কুইজ.exp:
Question: A tank has a length of 6 meters, a width of 3 meters, and a height of 5 meters. What is the water-holding capacity of the tank in liters?

Solution: 
দেওয়া আছে, 
চৌবাচ্চার দৈর্ঘ্য = 6 মিটার 
চৌবাচ্চার প্রস্থ = 3 মিটার 
চৌবাচ্চার উচ্চতা = 5 মিটার 

∴ চৌবাচ্চাটির পানি ধারণ ক্ষমতা = (দৈর্ঘ্য × প্রস্থ × উচ্চতা) ঘন একক 
= (6 × 3 × 5) ঘন মিটার 
= 90 ঘন মিটার 
= (90 × 1000) লিটার 
= 90000 লিটার
